newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end notch up in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end notch up in heavy trade.

text.p: MADRID, June 13 (Reuter) 1530 GMT - Madrid share prices closed a tad higher in heavy trade on Friday, after a bout of profit-taking took the indices off sharp gains, dealers said.
* General index up 1.42 points, 0.24 percent, to 582.29
* Some predictions the Ibex could test new highs next week
after the Amsterdam summit clears remaining EMU doubts
* Key blue chips continue climb, Telefonica adds 0.92 percent,
* Construction stocks still strong, Acciona up six percent
